genTemplate.name: Waiver and Assumption of Risk
genTemplate.description: Participant waiver acknowledging risks of an activity and releasing the organiser from claims arising from it.

activity.description: The activity the participant is taking part in.

activityDate.description: Date or date range of the activity.

risks.description: Specific known risks of the activity.

isMinor.description: True when the participant is under 18 and a guardian must sign.

risks: physical injury from falls, collisions or equipment failure
exposure to weather and environmental conditions
delay in reaching emergency medical care
loss of or damage to personal property

genTemplate.templateContent:
WAIVER AND ASSUMPTION OF RISK

I, {{partyB.name}}, wish to take part in {{activity}} (the “Activity”) organised by {{partyA.name}} (the “Organiser”) on {{activityDate}} at {{location}}. In exchange for being permitted to take part, I agree to the following.

1. Assumption of Risk

I understand that the Activity involves risks of injury, illness, property damage and, in some circumstances, death. Those risks include:

    {{#each risks}}
  1. {{this}}
    2. {{/each}}

I understand this list is not exhaustive and that other risks, known and unknown, exist. I knowingly and voluntarily assume all such risks, whether caused by the Activity itself, the conduct of other participants, the condition of the premises, or the ordinary negligence of the Organiser.

2. Release

To the fullest extent permitted by law, I release the Organiser and its officers, employees, volunteers and agents from all claims, demands and causes of action arising out of my participation in the Activity, including those arising from ordinary negligence. This release does not extend to gross negligence, recklessness, wilful misconduct, or any liability that cannot lawfully be released.

3. Fitness to Participate

I confirm that I am physically fit to take part, that I have disclosed any condition that could affect my safety or that of others, and that I will follow the Organiser’s rules and the reasonable instructions of its staff.

4. Medical Treatment

I authorise the Organiser to arrange emergency medical treatment if I am unable to consent, and I am responsible for the cost of that treatment. My emergency contact is {{emergencyContactName}}, {{emergencyContactPhone}}.

5. Media

I consent to the Organiser photographing or recording the Activity and using my image in connection with it, unless I notify the Organiser in writing that I withhold that consent.

6. Acknowledgement

I have read this document in full. I understand that it is a release of legal rights and that I sign it voluntarily. I understand I did not have to sign it and could have declined to take part. It is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, and if any part of it is held unenforceable the rest remains in force.

7. Participants Under 18

Where the participant is under 18, the parent or legal guardian signs on their behalf, agrees to these terms personally and on the participant’s behalf, and confirms they have authority to do so.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Waiver as of the Effective Date.
